phase: FX Inflation Pass-Through — Structural Selection Preregistration
purpose: Freeze numeric identifiability and predictive-selection gates for the single preregistered monthly FX candidate before any coefficient estimation. The candidate must add out-of-sample predictive information beyond inflation persistence, calendar seasonality and the retained import-UVI external-price baseline. Passing does not establish causal exchange-rate pass-through.

windows.final_evaluation_open_rule: Only a separately authorized execution that passes every frozen selection and identifiability gate may permit a later, separate final-evaluation gate. Selection failure leaves all 2021-01..2026-06 performance unopened.

identifiability_gates.rule: Any rank, zero-variance, conditioning or finite-value failure is an identification failure. No regularization, variable deletion, alternate lag blocks or target changes may rescue this cycle.

sign_consistency_gates.expected_direction: non-negative because positive de_t is RON depreciation

structural_selection_gates.rule: The FX candidate passes only if all gates pass. Improvement against persistence or AR alone cannot compensate for failure to improve the mandatory external-price baseline.

final_evaluation_gates_if_later_opened.refit_policy: At each final-evaluation origin refit the frozen model form only on target months strictly earlier than that origin.

diagnostics_not_selection_criteria.note: Diagnostics may justify a future separately preregistered cycle but may not respecify this cycle.

verdict_rules.PASS_TO_FINAL_EVALUATION: All frozen selection, sign and identifiability gates pass; a separate gate may then be considered for 2021-01..2026-06.
verdict_rules.FAIL_BEFORE_HOLDOUT: Any required gate fails; the final-evaluation window remains unopened and this tested form is frozen.
verdict_rules.interpretation: A failure rejects this specific predictive form within this evidence cycle, not the general economic existence of exchange-rate pass-through.

next_gate: Implement an offline guarded selection runner that exactly enforces this contract and defaults to no estimation. Only after runner tests and Scientific CI may one bounded 2015-01..2020-12 structural-selection execution be separately authorized.
